title: Skyscraping Markham Proposal Moves from Condo to Rental
summary: A proposal for a skyscraping residential tower in Markham, first proposed by the current owner at 30 storeys in 2022, then bumped to 45 storeys in 2023 after Major Transit Station Areas (MTSAs) were introduced, is morphing again after it was approved at 42 storeys in 2025. (The Province of Ontario is looking for denser development within MTSAs.) Currently home to a single-storey car wash facility, the site is next to low-rise commercial buildings to its north and west, and low-rise residential to the east.
